svg.title: Buff Your Money: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Buy (Owner): Buys Buff Your Money on the AgentBuff marketplace with an active AgentBuff account. 2. Sign in (Owner): Signs in with AgentBuff; BYM checks that the owner is entitled to the product. 3. Auto-connect (AgentBuff): Sends a short-lived signed assertion and BYM issues an MCP token for the owner's main book. 4. Consent in chat (AI agent): Shows the data processing summary and calls accept_terms only after the user agrees in their own words. 5. Set up in chat (AI agent): Sets payday, wallets with balances, a budget and a first goal without the user opening the app. 6. Record (AI agent): Turns "makan siang 35rb pakai gopay" into one quick_record call and replies with the new safe-to-spend figure. 7. Review (Owner): Opens the app for the home screen, review inbox, budgets, goals, net worth and reports. 8. Undo (Owner): Reverses any agent action from the Agent AI page, or asks the agent to undo the last one.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
